mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_warranty_renewal_record SET device_sn=#{command.row.deviceSn},warranty_contract_no=#{command.row.warrantyContractNo}, warranty_grade=#{command.row.warrantyGrade},warranty_start_date=#{command.row.warrantyStartDate}, warranty_end_date=#{command.row.warrantyEndDate},warranty_months=#{command.row.warrantyMonths}, extended=#{command.row.extended},is_latest=#{command.row.isLatest},remark=#{command.row.remark}, version=#{command.row.version},updater=#{command.row.updater},update_time=#{command.row.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id=#{command.row.tenantId} AND id=#{command.row.id} AND version=#{command.expectedVersion} AND deleted=FALSE
